comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A yellow-name Ganador, he can be challenged when the World Clock is set to the 15th Century's third through fifth periods, or if one equips Adept of Ages (15th Century-P.3) / Adept of Ages (15th Century-P.4) / Adept of Ages (15th Century-P.5) titles or Age effect (15th century) EX Effect equipment.

Can potentially drop the following when defeated:

Medium Storm Sail
Festival Wooden Paneling (note: presumed to be a JP-server drop only due to Maris Ganador nerfs)
Spanish Crest
Spanish Admiral Outfit
Blessing for the Victor
Flag of Spain (confirmed to be removed on Maris server)

Use サンタ・クルズ with Ctrl-F to locate his Ganador map on the following page:

66noa.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-44.html

He'll be the red dot.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Ganador/List
